source.section: Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 9,000.00 = 9,000.00. Federal taxable income = 9,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 0.00 (the figure is -6,750.00, entered as zero) (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. No Schedule E adjustments. IT-540 Line 7 federal AGI 9,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 9,000.00 - 12,500.00 = -3,500.00, less than zero, so the form enters 0; taxable income 0.00. Line 11 = 0.00 x .03 = 0.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 0.00. Any Louisiana Earned Income Credit (Line 16) on this income is outside the record and not applied.
accepted_approximations: Credits outside the record's scope are not applied: the Louisiana Earned Income Credit (Line 16, 5 percent of the federal credit), child care and school readiness credits, and the credit for income taxes paid to other states (Schedule C Line 1). Other Schedule E exemptions (START contributions, school expense deductions and similar) are not applied either.
